# ![](https://app.gusto.com/companies/99f9e918-d4d9-47de-8dd6-6eebde1acfc2/logo?v=1775573033)    Energy CircleDigital Marketing Account Manager  Portland, ME  ·   Full time  [Company website](https://www.energycircle.com/)    [Apply for Digital Marketing Account Manager](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/energy-circle-digital-marketing-account-manager-d2eeb3d2-f33b-483e-808a-e3aa71a5e9e8/applicants/new)

Digital Marketing Account Managers (DMAMs) at EC are strategic problem-solvers, organized account leaders, and trusted client partners. They are explorers, collaborators, and data-driven executors.

### About Energy Circle

Founded in 2008, Energy Circle is a digital marketing agency on a mission to accelerate the transformation of homes and buildings toward reduced carbon, renewable generation, greater energy efficiency, health, and comfort. We measure our performance in the success of our clients and their impact on the built environment. We are proud to be a Certified B Corp.

Our unique expertise is in business growth and lead generation for high performance contractors committed to a building science, whole-home approach, as well as manufacturers, non-profits, and trade organizations that support them.

As a culture, we're a small, flat organization where we work hard, have a strong sense of purpose, and a healthy respect for work-life balance. As a Certified B Corp, we strive to do great work with great people and have fun while doing it.

You will work with our CEO and Leadership Directors, your immediate team, and collaborate daily with the entire Energy Circle crew. You’ll report directly to the Director of Digital Marketing Strategy.

### Description

## Plan - Build - Track - Analyze - Optimize

Digital Marketing Account Managers (DMAMs) at EC are strategic problem-solvers, organized account leaders, and trusted client partners. They are explorers, collaborators, and data-driven executors.

Our DMAMs directly plan, work collaboratively to execute, and refine full-funnel digital strategies for our clients in the better-building sector (HVAC, home performance, and solar). This role requires a well-rounded digital marketing skill set, a strong analytical mindset, and a proactive approach to testing new tactics.

As our clients span diverse markets across the US, each audience demands a tailored multi-channel strategy. You will lead campaigns across the full funnel from awareness to lead generation, including:

- **Strategic Campaign Planning & Channel Strategy:** Developing integrated marketing plans across Paid and Organic Search, Creative Content Marketing (blogs > videos), Social Advertising, and Programmatic aligned with client business and marketing goals.
- **Conversion & User Experience:** Identifying optimizations for landing pages (UX/UI) and campaigns to maximize for increased brand awareness and lead generation.
- **Performance Tracking & Analytics:** Managing tracking platforms (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Data Studio, etc.) and interpreting performance data into actionable insights and tactics.
- **Continuous Optimization:** Conducting ongoing testing, reviewing and recommending tactic and budget allocations, and refining keyword/audience targets to meet and succeed against our clients’ objectives.
- **Client Management:** Directly owning the end-to-end client experience through regular strategic calls, proactive campaign updates, clear expectation management, and translating marketing metrics into executive-level insights that drive long-term client satisfaction and growth.
- **AI & Innovation:** Actively embrace, experiment, and integrate AI LLMs and automation tools  (Zapier) to enhance productivity and client impact, in accordance with Energy Circle’s Human-AI-Human loop and vetting guidelines, utilizing approved AI technologies as tools, not a strategic shortcut.

## Requirements:

### **Qualified applicants should have:**

- A degree in marketing, business management, communications, or something transferable
- Passion, enthusiasm, and 3–7 years of experience working in digital marketing
- A blend of quantitative and qualitative thinking abilities
- Ability to present (and clearly communicate) overarching marketing strategy, campaign objectives, and performance metrics
- Advanced organizational skills with an ability to prioritize and delegate tasks
- A desire to build and maintain strong, healthy, proactive client relationships primarily over Zoom, phone, and email
- Daily fluency with AI tools (Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) to prompt effectively, streamline daily workflows, and optimize team productivity
- Strong attention to detail and QA ownership of any work deliverable (AI or otherwise)
- Demonstrating our Zest for Innovation core value to improve or creatively rethink workflows and processes (AI, automation, or otherwise)
- The ability to work productively in a collaborative, close-knit team environment; we want participants!
- Experience (or strong interest) in the better building sectors including HVAC, solar, or home performance
- Above-average proficiency in Google Analytics and Google Suite platforms, including but not limited to Google Data Studio, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, etc.
- Local to Portland strongly preferred. Exceptional candidates considered for remote offer.

### **In an ideal world, you’d also have:**

- A track record of client service excellence
- Strong knowledge of many of the specific tactics and marketing services we deploy
- A track record of building your own small tools or automations (Zapier, custom GPTs, agents, light scripting) to take repetitive work off your plate
- Ability to query research and datasets in natural language from BigQuery, GA4, and Semrush to inform strategy and marketing tactics.
- Passion for supporting a mission-centric organization and the desire to join a highly collaborative team

## Salary & Benefits

- Starting Salary Range: $60,000 - $72,000
- 401(k) with employer matching contribution up to 4% via Betterment
- Health insurance benefit with option for dental and vision coverage
- “Take What You Need” PTO and sick time + 10 paid holidays per year
- Family leave for all parental roles
- Hybrid Office Schedule
- Downtown Portland, dog-friendly office, parking included
- A culture built on mutual respect, low ego, and zero tolerance for assholes!

## Our Commitment to Inclusivity

Energy Circle is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we strive to assemble a team of thoughtful, talented, and diverse employees who are invested in issues directly related to our mission, including environmental justice. We believe the more people with different backgrounds, cultures, perspectives, and experiences, the more successful our company will be, and we are always on the lookout for volunteer opportunities that support our mission in the surrounding community.

**Work Authorization & Location Requirements**

- Visa Sponsorship: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.
- Location & Relocation: While we are open to exceptional U.S.-based remote candidates, preference will be given to candidates who reside in—or are willing to self-relocate to—the greater Southern Maine region. Relocation assistance is not provided.

## How We Work With AI

We embrace the power of AI in the same way we approach building performance: as a discipline, not a gadget. The same principles that guide how we help buildings do more with less guide how we use these tools.

- **Measure.** As a company built on measurement and working on our B Corp recertification, we hold our own AI use to the same standard. We are striving to account for its real resource footprint — energy, water, carbon.
- **Sufficiency Discipline**. We ask whether a task actually warrants AI, or whether a simpler, lighter-weight approach would do the job just as well. Not every problem needs a large model.
- **Efficiency Choices.** When AI is the right tool, we choose to reach the outcome with the least impact.

**The Human–AI–Human Model**

- **Human Start:** Strategy and industry expertise come from our team.
- **AI Middle**: Used for data analysis, brainstorming, and scaling repetitive tasks.
- **Human End:** Every output is reviewed and refined by an expert before delivery.

Above all, we use AI to add more value to our clients' businesses, not to pad our own margins.

[Apply for Digital Marketing Account Manager](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/energy-circle-digital-marketing-account-manager-d2eeb3d2-f33b-483e-808a-e3aa71a5e9e8/applicants/new)
